<thought>To obtain the precursors, I will apply the retrosynthetic template with ID 1914391 to the product molecule. The product SMILES can be taken from the mapped reaction string (right‑hand side after “>>”), stripping the atom‑mapping annotations. I will use the `apply_template` tool with this product SMILES and the template ID. The tool will return all possible precursor SMILES combinations.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCOC(=O)CH2C1CC(O)C(C)(C)C(=C(C)C(=O)OCH3)O1",
    "template_id": "1914391"
}</action_input>
